signIn.title: Who is cleaning?
signIn.subtitle: Tap your name
signIn.noCleaners: No cleaners are set up for this site yet. Ask your supervisor.

consent.title: Before you start
consent.body: This app records photos, notes, timers and test results while you clean. These records are kept for food safety and may be checked by your supervisor, quality team and auditors.

tasks.title: Tonight's cleaning
tasks.none: No tasks for you tonight. Ask your supervisor.
tasks.noShift: There is no shift planned yet.

step.cantDoTitle: Why can't you do this step?
step.photoNeeded: Take a photo to finish this step
step.finishEarlyConfirm: Timer not finished. Tap again to finish early.
step.atpFailHelp: Tell your supervisor. Clean this area again from the foam step, then swab again.
step.saveFailed: Could not save. Check signal and try again.

complete.title: Task finished
complete.body: Well done. Your supervisor will see this once it has synced.
